description: Commit-reveal verification of AI-agent trade claims against a Pyth oracle on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.31.1). initialize, register_agent, configure_policy, lock_escrow, commit and verify_and_execute were verified on both the approved path (escrow executed, 1_000_000 paid out) and the mismatch path (refund plus stake slash).
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of yigitturaan/Aegis. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/aegis-verifier (Blockchains/aegis is an unrelated fork of a different project). The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (agent stake, policy, escrow, commit-reveal, Pyth price verification)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/aegis/
QA: devnet proof of approved and rejected verify_and_execute
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)
Real Jupiter swap CPI (the program uses a 1:1 mock swap amount)

assignments.title: Exercise refund after escrow expiry and the admin slash instruction
